Package org.Jtech.Service

Class OpenAIService

java.lang.Object
org.Jtech.Service.OpenAIService
@Service public class OpenAIService extends Object
OpenAI Service Purpose: Handles AI-driven processing for product-related workflows, including extraction of product details from unstructured text, product evaluation, usage guidance generation, and chemical classification. Scope: - Extract structured product details from OCR text - Evaluate products based on ingredients and user context - Generate product usage guidance - Identify beneficial and harmful chemicals Metadata: Added on : 2026-02-06 Author : Mohit Singh Notes: This service encapsulates all interactions with the AI model. Prompt generation and response parsing are delegated to trainer and parser utilities to keep responsibilities separated. Security: API keys retrieved by this service must never be logged or exposed outside trusted service layers.

    • extractProductDetailsFromText

      public ProductChemicalResponseDTO extractProductDetailsFromText(String productText)
      Extract structured product details from unstructured OCR text. Used for: - Processing raw OCR output from scanned product labels - Extracting product name, category, chemical list, expiry date, and price information
      Parameters:
      productText - unstructured OCR text obtained from product label scanning
      Returns:
      extracted structured product details, or null if extraction fails

    • fetchProductUsageGuide

      Parameters:

      Returns:

    • fetchGoodChemicalTable

      public GoodChemicalResponseDTO fetchGoodChemicalTable(GoodChemicalRequestDTO goodChemicalRequestDTO)
      Retrieve beneficial (good) chemicals identified in a product. Used for: - Identifying safe or beneficial chemicals present in a product - Displaying positive ingredient information to users
